fields.description: Issue includes editorials and reporting on renewed proposals for Dade County/city consolidation; a major story alleging links between Rev. Joseph Barth and Dr. T. Earl Moore and discussing a former patient’s treatment and related correspondence; coverage of a large new oil well in the Sunniland field (Collier County) and implications for South Florida; local court/crime notes and calls for improved death investigation; notices and commentary on civic education/oratorical contests promoting Americanism in Dade County schools; and additional pieces on spiritualist practices, public affairs, and health topics including cigarette smoking and lung cancer.
